Name: Scale
Description: The perceptual scale of the Voronoi shapes. Higher values create more shapes.

Name: Jitter
Description: Control the offset of the Voronoi points between symmetrical and chaotic.

Flubs.Name: C
Flubs.Description: Voronoi cells with height decided by the cells themselves.

Flubs.Name: N
Flubs.Description: Voronoi cells with height decided by the nearest neighbor.

Flubs.Name: P
Flubs.Description: The default look for this geo-variant, suitable for creating mountains.

Flubs.Name: A
Flubs.Description: A mix between P and M.

Flubs.Name: S
Flubs.Description: Individual mountains with fully separated boundaries.

Flubs.Name: M
Flubs.Description: Favors the strongest cell; good for creating a big mountain slope.

Name: Seed
Description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process.

Name: Scale X
Description: The non-uniform scale of the X axis.

Name: Scale Y
Description: The non-uniform scale of the Y axis.
